NotArmed.Cause: Arming, approval, expiry, trigger or maintenance check failed; no write occurred.

BadInput.Cause: Invalid, redriven or stale input; no write occurred.

InterlockFailed.Cause: Legacy schedule contract differs; no runtime write permitted.

Failed.Cause: A task, invariant, lease, readiness or timeout failed. Inspect execution history; independent backstops remain required.
